Name: Custom Silo Hay Capacity
Author: SquidlyJesus
Description:
[size=6]Custom Silo Hay Capacity[/size]

240 hay is just not enough capacity for how much grass you cut, and while that's honestly plenty for most cases and there are workarounds in vanilla gameplay sometimes you just want to not worry about all that stuff and just let a silo be a silo.

There are a ton of different silo capacity mods out there, a number of which are outdated now, but for some reason I always felt like I had to change the value myself anyways so I made a mod. Maybe it's a little redundant right now with how many other options there are, some of them better or make changes to other things as well, but sometimes mods are about what you can do rather than what is needed.

I also just prefer this name, this is what is should be called. Not "size" or "storage" or anything like that. You're not making the silo bigger, or adding a storage slot... Sorry, just a little pet peeve of mine. "HayCapacity" is also what it's know as internally.

This mod has "Custom" as the default, but you can also set it to some presets if you prefer some arbitrary big numbers. Anything higher than a couple thousand is already redundant, but still.

[size=5]Option Details[/size]

[size=3]Custom[/size]
Whatever value you want.
Default of 50,000

[size=3]Chest x9[/size]
The same as putting 999 hay in each of the 36 slots of 9 Chests.
Amount: 35964

[size=3]Big Chest x9[/size]
The same as putting 999 hay into each of the 70 slots of the new Big Chest.
Amount: 69930

[size=3]Big Shed[/size]
The same as putting 999 hay into each of the 70 slots of 204 Big Chests which can barely fit into a shed. You'd have to pick up empty chests to get to the back of this theoretical shed.
Amount: 14,265,720

[size=3]No Change [/size]
No change whatsoever. Disables the mod.
Amount: 240

[size=3]10 Thousand [/size]
Just set to an even 10,000 hay.
Amount: 10,000

[size=3]1 Million[/size]
Just set to an even 1,000,000 hay.
Amount: 1,000,000

[size=5]Installation[/size]
Install it like any other mod, along with Content Patcher. You can then use Generic Mod Config Menu if you feel like it.

Also check out my other mod. It makes bigger changes to the game.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7351]Modular Map Edits
[/url]
